import math

int floor_ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    if numerator >= 0
        return numerator / denominator
    return -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

int rounded(int numerator, int denominator)
    return floor_ratio(2 * numerator + denominator, 2 * denominator)

int away(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if numerator < 0 then -rounded(-numerator, denominator) else rounded(numerator, denominator)

int modulo(int value, int divisor)
    return (value % divisor + divisor) % divisor

int clamp(int value)
    return math.min(255, math.max(0, value))

int root_ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    low := 0
    high := 1
    while high * high * denominator <= numerator
        high *= 2
    while low + 1 < high
        middle := (low + high) / 2
        if middle * middle * denominator <= numerator
            low = middle
        else
            high = middle
    return low

int index_of(string value, string[] values)
    for: i < #values
        if values[i] == value
            return int(i)
    return -1

bool member(string value, string words)
    return index_of(value, words.split(" ")) >= 0

string[] builtin_names()
    return ["black", "maroon", "green", "olive", "navy", "purple", "teal", "silver", "gray", "red", "lime", "yellow", "blue", "magenta", "cyan", "white", "orange", "pink", "brown", "gold", "coral", "salmon", "violet", "indigo"]

int[][] builtin_colors()
    return [[0, 0, 0], [128, 0, 0], [0, 128, 0], [128, 128, 0], [0, 0, 128], [128, 0, 128], [0, 128, 128], [192, 192, 192], [128, 128, 128], [255, 0, 0], [0, 255, 0], [255, 255, 0], [0, 0, 255], [255, 0, 255], [0, 255, 255], [255, 255, 255], [255, 165, 0], [255, 192, 203], [165, 42, 42], [255, 215, 0], [255, 127, 80], [250, 128, 114], [238, 130, 238], [75, 0, 130]]

int hex_digit(string character)
    alphabet := "0123456789abcdefABCDEF"
    match alphabet.find(character)
        nat position
            return if position < 16 then int(position) else int(position) - 6
        none
            return -1

bool digits(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

(bool, int) integer(string text, int low, int high)
    magnitude := text
    negative := false
    if text.starts_with("-")
        magnitude = text[1:]
        negative = true
    if #magnitude < 1 or #magnitude > 9 or not digits(magnitude)
        return (false, 0)
    value := int(magnitude)
    if negative
        value = -value
    return (low <= value <= high, value)

bool valid_name(string text)
    if #text < 1 or #text > 12
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

int[] parse_color(string text, string[] names, int[][] colors)
    if text.starts_with("#")
        if #text != 4 and #text != 7
            return []
        int[] result := []
        width := if #text == 4 then 1 else 2
        for: 0 <= i < 3
            first := hex_digit(text[1 + i * width])
            second := if width == 1 then first else hex_digit(text[2 + i * width])
            if first < 0 or second < 0
                return []
            result = result.append(first * 16 + second)
        return result
    if text.starts_with("rgb(") and text.ends_with(")")
        components := text[4:<#text - 1].split(",")
        if #components != 3
            return []
        int[] result := []
        for component := components[]
            if #component < 1 or #component > 3 or not digits(component)
                return []
            value := int(component)
            if value > 255
                return []
            result = result.append(value)
        return result
    position := index_of(text, names)
    return if position < 0 then [] else colors[position]

string hexadecimal(int value, int width)
    if width <= 0
        return ""
    low := nat(value % 16 ^ width)
    hex := low.B16
    return "0" * (width - #hex) + hex

string color_text(int[] color)
    return "#{hexadecimal(color[0], 2)}{hexadecimal(color[1], 2)}{hexadecimal(color[2], 2)}"

string sequence_text(int[][] colors)
    fields := [for color := colors[] then color_text(color)]
    return fields.join(" ")

int distance(int[] first, int[] second)
    return ((first - second) ^ 2).sum()

nat nearest_index(int[] target, int[][] candidates)
    distances := [for candidate := candidates[] then distance(target, candidate)]
    return distances.indices()[distances <= distances.min()][0]

int hue(int[] color)
    r := color[0]
    g := color[1]
    b := color[2]
    largest := color.max()
    delta := largest - color.min()
    if delta == 0
        return 0
    numerator := 0
    if largest == r
        numerator = 60 * (g - b)
        if numerator < 0
            numerator += 360 * delta
    elif largest == g
        numerator = 60 * (b - r) + 120 * delta
    else
        numerator = 60 * (r - g) + 240 * delta
    return modulo(rounded(numerator, delta), 360)

int[] hsl(int[] color)
    largest := color.max()
    smallest := color.min()
    delta := largest - smallest
    saturation := if delta == 0 then 0 else rounded(100 * delta, 255 - math.abs(largest + smallest - 255))
    return [hue(color), saturation, rounded(100 * (largest + smallest), 510)]

int[] factors(int angle)
    sector := angle / 60
    fraction := angle % 60
    x := if sector % 2 == 0 then fraction else 60 - fraction
    int[][] choices := [[60, x, 0], [x, 60, 0], [0, 60, x], [0, x, 60], [x, 0, 60], [60, 0, x]]
    return choices[sector]

int[] from_hsl(int angle, int saturation, int lightness)
    chroma := (100 - math.abs(2 * lightness - 100)) * saturation
    base_factors := factors(angle)
    return [for factor := base_factors[] then rounded(255 * (chroma * (factor - 30) + 6000 * lightness), 600000)]

int[] from_hsv(int angle, int saturation, int value)
    chroma := value * saturation
    base_factors := factors(angle)
    return [for factor := base_factors[] then rounded(255 * (chroma * (factor - 60) + 6000 * value), 600000)]

int[] from_hwb(int angle, int whiteness, int blackness)
    if whiteness + blackness >= 100
        value := rounded(255 * whiteness, whiteness + blackness)
        return [value, value, value]
    base_factors := factors(angle)
    return [for factor := base_factors[] then rounded(255 * (factor * (100 - whiteness - blackness) + 60 * whiteness), 6000)]

int[] model(string name, int[] color)
    r := color[0]
    g := color[1]
    b := color[2]
    largest := color.max()
    smallest := color.min()
    delta := largest - smallest
    if name == "HSL"
        return hsl(color)
    if name == "HSV"
        saturation := if largest == 0 then 0 else rounded(100 * delta, largest)
        return [hue(color), saturation, rounded(100 * largest, 255)]
    if name == "HWB"
        return [hue(color), rounded(100 * smallest, 255), rounded(100 * (255 - largest), 255)]
    if name == "CMYK"
        if largest == 0
            return [0, 0, 0, 100]
        return [rounded(100 * (largest - r), largest), rounded(100 * (largest - g), largest), rounded(100 * (largest - b), largest), rounded(100 * (255 - largest), 255)]
    y := rounded(299 * r + 587 * g + 114 * b, 1000)
    if name == "YIQ"
        return [y, rounded(596 * r - 274 * g - 322 * b, 1000), rounded(211 * r - 523 * g + 312 * b, 1000)]
    return [clamp(y), clamp(rounded(128000 - 169 * r - 331 * g + 500 * b, 1000)), clamp(rounded(128000 + 500 * r - 419 * g - 81 * b, 1000))]

string model_text(string name, int[] color)
    values := model(name, color)
    if name == "HSL"
        return "hsl({values[0]},{values[1]}%,{values[2]}%)"
    if name == "HSV"
        return "hsv({values[0]},{values[1]}%,{values[2]}%)"
    if name == "HWB"
        return "hwb({values[0]},{values[1]}%,{values[2]}%)"
    if name == "CMYK"
        return "cmyk({values[0]}%,{values[1]}%,{values[2]}%,{values[3]}%)"
    if name == "YIQ"
        return "yiq({values[0]},{values[1]},{values[2]})"
    return "ycbcr({values[0]},{values[1]},{values[2]})"

int[] ansi_color(int number)
    if number < 16
        colors := builtin_colors()
        return colors[number]
    if number >= 232
        value := 8 + 10 * (number - 232)
        return [value, value, value]
    levels := [0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255]
    value := number - 16
    return [levels[value / 36], levels[value / 6 % 6], levels[value % 6]]

int luminance(int[] color)
    return 2126 * color[0] * color[0] + 7152 * color[1] * color[1] + 722 * color[2] * color[2]

int[] contrast(int[] first, int[] second)
    a := luminance(first)
    b := luminance(second)
    high := math.max(a, b) + 32512500
    low := math.min(a, b) + 32512500
    verdict := if high >= 7 * low then 2 elif 2 * high >= 9 * low then 1 else 0
    return [rounded(100 * high, low), verdict]

string contrast_text(int[] first, int[] second)
    result := contrast(first, second)
    whole := result[0] / 100
    fraction := result[0] % 100
    verdicts := ["FAIL", "AA", "AAA"]
    return "{whole}.{fraction:02.} {verdicts[result[1]]}"

int[][] gradient(int[] first, int[] second, int count)
    return [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then
        [for channel := (0:<3)[] then first[channel] + away((second[channel] - first[channel]) * i, count - 1)]]

int[] mean_color(int[][] colors)
    totals := [0, 0, 0]
    for color := colors[]
        totals += color
    return [for total := totals[] then rounded(total, int(#colors))]

int[] widths(int[][] colors)
    low := colors[0]
    high := colors[0]
    for color := colors[]
        for: 0 <= channel < 3
            low[channel] = math.min(low[channel], color[channel])
            high[channel] = math.max(high[channel], color[channel])
    return high - low

int[][][] palette(int[][] colors, int count)
    boxes := [colors]
    while int(#boxes) < count
        selected := -1
        widest := -1
        channel := 0
        for: 0 <= i < int(#boxes)
            if #boxes[i] < 2
                continue
            spans := widths(boxes[i])
            component := 0
            for: 1 <= j < 3
                if spans[j] > spans[component]
                    component = j
            if spans[component] > widest
                selected = i
                widest = spans[component]
                channel = component
        box := boxes[selected]
        for: 1 <= i < int(#box)
            value := box[i]
            j := i - 1
            while j >= 0 and box[j][channel] > value[channel]
                box[j + 1] = box[j]
                j -= 1
            box[j + 1] = value
        middle := int(#box) / 2
        int[][][] next := []
        for: 0 <= i < int(#boxes)
            if i == selected
                next = next.append(box[:<middle])
                next = next.append(box[middle:])
            else
                next = next.append(boxes[i])
        boxes = next
    return boxes

int blend_component(string mode, int x, int y)
    multiplied := x * y / 255
    screened := 255 - (255 - x) * (255 - y) / 255
    if mode == "MULTIPLY"
        return multiplied
    if mode == "SCREEN"
        return screened
    if mode == "OVERLAY" or mode == "HARDLIGHT"
        low := if mode == "OVERLAY" then x < 128 else y < 128
        return if low then 2 * x * y / 255 else 255 - 2 * (255 - x) * (255 - y) / 255
    if mode == "SOFTLIGHT"
        return ((255 - x) * multiplied + x * screened) / 255
    if mode == "DARKEN"
        return math.min(x, y)
    if mode == "LIGHTEN"
        return math.max(x, y)
    if mode == "DIFFERENCE"
        return math.abs(x - y)
    if mode == "EXCLUSION"
        return x + y - 2 * x * y / 255
    if mode == "ADD"
        return math.min(255, x + y)
    if mode == "SUBTRACT"
        return math.max(0, x - y)
    if mode == "COLORDODGE"
        return if y == 255 then 255 else math.min(255, 255 * x / (255 - y))
    return if y == 0 then 0 else math.max(0, 255 - 255 * (255 - x) / y)

string schema(string command, int count)
    if command == "BEST"
        return if 2 <= count <= 33 then "C" * nat(count) else "?"
    if command == "SORT" or command == "DITHER"
        return if 1 <= count <= 32 then "C" * nat(count) else "?"
    if command == "PALETTE" or command == "KMEANS"
        return if 2 <= count <= 33 then "B" + "C" * nat(count - 1) else "?"
    definitions := ["PARSE C", "DEFINE NC", "UNDEFINE N", "LIST", "HSL C", "FROMHSL HPP", "HSV C", "FROMHSV HPP", "HWB C", "FROMHWB HPP", "CMYK C", "FROMCMYK PPPP", "YCBCR C", "FROMYCBCR YYY", "YIQ C", "FROMYIQ YII", "RGB565 C", "FROM565 X", "ANSI C", "FROMANSI Y", "WEBSAFE C", "GRAY CK", "INVERT C", "MIX CCP", "MIXHSL CCP", "GRADIENT CCG", "TINTS CT", "SHADES CT", "TONES CT", "BLEND KCC", "ALPHA CPCP", "SIMULATE CK", "ROTATE CD", "COMPLEMENT C", "TRIADIC C", "TETRADIC C", "SPLITCOMP C", "ANALOGOUS CAS", "LIGHTEN CP", "DARKEN CP", "SATURATE CP", "DESATURATE CP", "NEAREST C", "DISTANCE CC", "CONTRAST CC", "ACCESSIBLE CC", "DESCRIBE C", "RANDOM RU"]
    for definition := definitions[]
        parts := definition.split(" ")
        if parts[0] == command
            result := if #parts == 1 then "" else parts[1]
            return if int(#result) == count then result else "?"
    return "?"

string execute(string[] words, string[] &registered_names, int[][] &registered_colors)
    command := words[0]
    arguments := words[1:]
    kinds := schema(command, int(#arguments))
    if kinds == "?"
        return "INVALID"
    string[] names := builtin_names().concat(registered_names)
    int[][] colors := builtin_colors().concat(registered_colors)
    int[] empty_color := []
    int[][] parsed := array(#arguments, fill = empty_color)
    numbers := array(#arguments, fill = 0)
    for: i < #arguments
        kind := kinds[i]
        argument := arguments[i]
        if kind == "C"
            parsed[i] = parse_color(argument, names, colors)
            if #parsed[i] != 3
                return "INVALID"
        elif kind == "N"
            if not valid_name(argument)
                return "INVALID"
        elif kind == "K"
            keywords := if command == "GRAY" then "LUMA AVERAGE LIGHTNESS HSP" elif command == "SIMULATE" then "PROTANOPIA DEUTERANOPIA TRITANOPIA ACHROMATOPSIA" else "MULTIPLY SCREEN OVERLAY HARDLIGHT SOFTLIGHT DARKEN LIGHTEN DIFFERENCE EXCLUSION ADD SUBTRACT COLORDODGE COLORBURN HUE SATURATION COLOR LUMINOSITY"
            if not member(argument, keywords)
                return "INVALID"
        elif kind == "X"
            if #argument != 6 or not argument.starts_with("0x")
                return "INVALID"
            value := 0
            for: 2 <= j < 6
                digit := hex_digit(argument[j])
                if digit < 0
                    return "INVALID"
                value = value * 16 + digit
            numbers[i] = value
        else
            low := 0
            high := 100
            if kind == "H"
                high = 359
            elif kind == "Y"
                high = 255
            elif kind == "I"
                low = -255
                high = 255
            elif kind == "D"
                low = -720
                high = 720
            elif kind == "G"
                low = 2
                high = 16
            elif kind == "T"
                low = 1
                high = 10
            elif kind == "A"
                low = 1
                high = 6
            elif kind == "S"
                low = 1
                high = 60
            elif kind == "R"
                low = 1
                high = 999999999
            elif kind == "U"
                low = 1
                high = 16
            elif kind == "B"
                low = 1
                high = 32
            valid, value := integer(argument, low, high)
            if not valid
                return "INVALID"
            numbers[i] = value
    if (command == "PALETTE" or command == "KMEANS") and numbers[0] > int(#arguments) - 1
        return "INVALID"

    if command == "DEFINE"
        name := arguments[0]
        if index_of(name, builtin_names()) >= 0
            return "INVALID"
        position := index_of(name, registered_names)
        if position >= 0
            registered_colors[position] = parsed[1]
        else
            registered_names = registered_names.append(name)
            registered_colors = registered_colors.append(parsed[1])
        return "{name} {color_text(parsed[1])}"
    if command == "UNDEFINE"
        position := index_of(arguments[0], registered_names)
        if position < 0
            return "INVALID"
        keep := [for i := (0:<int(#registered_names))[] if i != position then i]
        registered_names = registered_names[keep]
        registered_colors = registered_colors[keep]
        return "{arguments[0]} removed"
    if command == "LIST"
        if #registered_names == 0
            return "NONE"
        ordered := registered_names.sorted()
        result := [for name := ordered[] then "{name}={color_text(registered_colors[index_of(name, registered_names)])}"]
        return result.join(" ")

    int[] first := if #parsed > 0 then parsed[0] else []
    int[] second := if #parsed > 1 then parsed[1] else []
    if member(command, "HSL HSV HWB CMYK YCBCR YIQ")
        return model_text(command, first)
    if command == "PARSE"
        matching := "-"
        for: i < #names
            if colors[i] == first
                matching = names[i]
                break
        result := [color_text(first), "rgb({first[0]},{first[1]},{first[2]})"]
        models := ["HSL", "HSV", "HWB", "CMYK", "YCBCR", "YIQ"]
        result = result.concat([for name := models[] then model_text(name, first)])
        result = result.append(matching)
        return result.join(" ")
    if command == "FROMHSL"
        return color_text(from_hsl(numbers[0], numbers[1], numbers[2]))
    if command == "FROMHSV"
        return color_text(from_hsv(numbers[0], numbers[1], numbers[2]))
    if command == "FROMHWB"
        return color_text(from_hwb(numbers[0], numbers[1], numbers[2]))
    if command == "FROMCMYK"
        result := [for i := (0:<3)[] then rounded(255 * (100 - numbers[i]) * (100 - numbers[3]), 10000)]
        return color_text(result)
    if command == "FROMYCBCR"
        y := numbers[0]
        cb := numbers[1] - 128
        cr := numbers[2] - 128
        return color_text([clamp(rounded(1000 * y + 1402 * cr, 1000)), clamp(rounded(1000 * y - 344 * cb - 714 * cr, 1000)), clamp(rounded(1000 * y + 1772 * cb, 1000))])
    if command == "FROMYIQ"
        y := numbers[0]
        i := numbers[1]
        q := numbers[2]
        return color_text([clamp(rounded(1000 * y + 956 * i + 619 * q, 1000)), clamp(rounded(1000 * y - 272 * i - 647 * q, 1000)), clamp(rounded(1000 * y - 1106 * i + 1703 * q, 1000))])
    if command == "RGB565"
        value := 2048 * rounded(31 * first[0], 255) + 32 * rounded(63 * first[1], 255) + rounded(31 * first[2], 255)
        return "0x{hexadecimal(value, 4)}"
    if command == "FROM565"
        value := numbers[0]
        return color_text([rounded(255 * (value / 2048), 31), rounded(255 * (value / 32 % 64), 63), rounded(255 * (value % 32), 31)])
    if command == "FROMANSI"
        return color_text(ansi_color(numbers[0]))
    if command == "ANSI"
        candidates := [for code := (16:<256)[] then ansi_color(code)]
        best := nearest_index(first, candidates)
        return "{best + 16} {color_text(candidates[best])} {distance(first, candidates[best])}"
    if command == "NEAREST"
        best := nearest_index(first, colors)
        return "{names[best]} {color_text(colors[best])} {distance(first, colors[best])}"
    if command == "WEBSAFE" or command == "INVERT" or command == "GRAY"
        if command == "GRAY"
            method := arguments[1]
            value := 0
            if method == "LUMA"
                value = rounded(299 * first[0] + 587 * first[1] + 114 * first[2], 1000)
            elif method == "AVERAGE"
                value = rounded(first.sum(), 3)
            elif method == "LIGHTNESS"
                value = rounded(first.max() + first.min(), 2)
            else
                value = root_ratio(299 * first[0] * first[0] + 587 * first[1] * first[1] + 114 * first[2] * first[2], 1000)
            return color_text([value, value, value])
        if command == "INVERT"
            return color_text([for component := first[] then 255 - component])
        return color_text([for component := first[] then 51 * rounded(component, 51)])
    if command == "MIX"
        p := numbers[2]
        numerators := first * (100 - p) + second * p
        return color_text([for value := numerators[] then rounded(value, 100)])
    if command == "MIXHSL"
        a := hsl(first)
        b := hsl(second)
        p := numbers[2]
        delta := modulo(b[0] - a[0], 360)
        if delta > 180
            delta -= 360
        return color_text(from_hsl(modulo(a[0] + away(delta * p, 100), 360), a[1] + away((b[1] - a[1]) * p, 100), a[2] + away((b[2] - a[2]) * p, 100)))
    if command == "GRADIENT"
        return sequence_text(gradient(first, second, numbers[2]))
    if member(command, "TINTS SHADES TONES")
        value := if command == "TINTS" then 255 elif command == "SHADES" then 0 else 128
        count := numbers[1]
        result := gradient(first, [value, value, value], count + 2)
        return sequence_text(result[1:<count + 1])
    if command == "BLEND"
        mode := arguments[0]
        base_color := parsed[1]
        top_color := parsed[2]
        if member(mode, "HUE SATURATION COLOR LUMINOSITY")
            a := hsl(base_color)
            b := hsl(top_color)
            if mode == "HUE" or mode == "COLOR"
                a[0] = b[0]
            if mode == "SATURATION" or mode == "COLOR"
                a[1] = b[1]
            if mode == "LUMINOSITY"
                a[2] = b[2]
            return color_text(from_hsl(a[0], a[1], a[2]))
        return color_text([for i := (0:<3)[] then blend_component(mode, base_color[i], top_color[i])])
    if command == "ALPHA"
        p := numbers[1]
        q := numbers[3]
        opacity := 100 * p + q * (100 - p)
        result := [0, 0, 0]
        if opacity > 0
            numerators := parsed[0] * (100 * p) + parsed[2] * (q * (100 - p))
            result = [for value := numerators[] then rounded(value, opacity)]
        return "{color_text(result)} {rounded(opacity, 100)}%"
    if command == "SIMULATE"
        type := arguments[1]
        int[][] matrix := [[299, 587, 114], [299, 587, 114], [299, 587, 114]]
        if type == "PROTANOPIA"
            matrix = [[567, 433, 0], [558, 442, 0], [0, 242, 758]]
        elif type == "DEUTERANOPIA"
            matrix = [[625, 375, 0], [700, 300, 0], [0, 300, 700]]
        elif type == "TRITANOPIA"
            matrix = [[950, 50, 0], [0, 433, 567], [0, 475, 525]]
        return color_text([for row := matrix[] then rounded(row.dot(first), 1000)])
    if member(command, "ROTATE COMPLEMENT TRIADIC TETRADIC SPLITCOMP ANALOGOUS LIGHTEN DARKEN SATURATE DESATURATE")
        values := hsl(first)
        int[] shifts := []
        if command == "ROTATE"
            shifts = [numbers[1]]
        elif command == "COMPLEMENT"
            shifts = [180]
        elif command == "TRIADIC"
            shifts = [120, 240]
        elif command == "TETRADIC"
            shifts = [90, 180, 270]
        elif command == "SPLITCOMP"
            shifts = [150, 210]
        elif command == "ANALOGOUS"
            k := numbers[1]
            shifts = [for i := (int(-k):<(int(k) + 1))[] if i != 0 then i * numbers[2]]
        else
            p := numbers[1]
            if command == "LIGHTEN"
                values[2] = math.min(100, values[2] + p)
            elif command == "DARKEN"
                values[2] = math.max(0, values[2] - p)
            elif command == "SATURATE"
                values[1] = math.min(100, values[1] + p)
            else
                values[1] = math.max(0, values[1] - p)
            return color_text(from_hsl(values[0], values[1], values[2]))
        return sequence_text([for shift := shifts[] then from_hsl(modulo(values[0] + shift, 360), values[1], values[2])])
    if command == "DISTANCE"
        dr := first[0] - second[0]
        dg := first[1] - second[1]
        db := first[2] - second[2]
        weighted := (1024 + first[0] + second[0]) * dr * dr + 2048 * dg * dg + (1534 - first[0] - second[0]) * db * db
        return "{distance(first, second)} {root_ratio(weighted, 512)}"
    if command == "CONTRAST"
        return contrast_text(first, second)
    if command == "ACCESSIBLE"
        selected := first
        original := contrast(first, second)
        if original[1] == 0
            values := hsl(first)
            found := false
            for: 1 <= step <= 100
                lightnesses := [values[2] - step, values[2] + step]
                for lightness := lightnesses[]
                    if 0 <= lightness <= 100
                        candidate := from_hsl(values[0], values[1], lightness)
                        assessment := contrast(candidate, second)
                        if assessment[1] != 0
                            selected = candidate
                            found = true
                            break
                if found
                    break
        return "{color_text(selected)} {contrast_text(selected, second)}"
    if command == "BEST"
        best := 1
        assessment := contrast(parsed[1], first)
        for: 2 <= i < int(#parsed)
            candidate := contrast(parsed[i], first)
            if candidate[0] > assessment[0]
                best = i
                assessment = candidate
        return "{color_text(parsed[best])} {contrast_text(parsed[best], first)}"
    if command == "DESCRIBE"
        values := hsl(first)
        lightness := values[2]
        if lightness <= 5
            return "black"
        if lightness >= 95
            return "white"
        light_word := if lightness <= 20 then "very dark" elif lightness <= 40 then "dark" elif lightness <= 60 then "medium" elif lightness <= 80 then "light" else "very light"
        if values[1] < 10
            return "{light_word} gray"
        saturation := if values[1] < 40 then "muted" elif values[1] < 80 then "moderate" else "vivid"
        hues := ["red", "orange", "yellow", "chartreuse", "green", "spring-green", "cyan", "azure", "blue", "violet", "magenta", "rose"]
        return "{light_word} {saturation} {hues[(values[0] + 15) % 360 / 30]}"
    if command == "PALETTE" or command == "KMEANS"
        k := numbers[0]
        source := parsed[1:]
        boxes := palette(source, k)
        representatives := [for box := boxes[] then mean_color(box)]
        int[] counts := []
        iterations := 0
        if command == "PALETTE"
            counts = [for box := boxes[] then int(#box)]
        else
            for: 1 <= iteration <= 20
                iterations = iteration
                int[][][] assigned := array(nat(k), fill = source[:<0])
                for color := source[]
                    best := nearest_index(color, representatives)
                    assigned[best] = assigned[best].append(color)
                next := representatives
                counts = []
                for: 0 <= j < k
                    counts = counts.append(int(#assigned[j]))
                    if #assigned[j] > 0
                        next[j] = mean_color(assigned[j])
                equal := next == representatives
                representatives = next
                if equal
                    break
        result := [for i := (0:<int(k))[] then "{color_text(representatives[i])}:{counts[i]}"]
        text := result.join(" ")
        return if command == "KMEANS" then "{iterations} {text}" else text
    if command == "SORT"
        result := parsed
        for: 1 <= i < int(#result)
            color := result[i]
            key := hsl(color)
            j := i - 1
            while j >= 0
                previous := hsl(result[j])
                greater := false
                for: 0 <= channel < 3
                    if previous[channel] != key[channel]
                        greater = previous[channel] > key[channel]
                        break
                if not greater
                    break
                result[j + 1] = result[j]
                j -= 1
            result[j + 1] = color
        return sequence_text(result)
    if command == "DITHER"
        choices := builtin_colors()[:<16]
        diffusion := [0, 0, 0]
        string[] result := []
        for color := parsed[]
            shifted := color + diffusion
            adjusted := [for component := shifted[] then clamp(component)]
            best := nearest_index(adjusted, choices)
            diffusion = adjusted - choices[best]
            result = result.append(names[best])
        return result.join(" ")
    if command == "RANDOM"
        state := numbers[0]
        int[][] result := []
        for: 0 <= i < numbers[1]
            state = state * 48271 % 2147483647
            angle := state % 360
            state = state * 48271 % 2147483647
            saturation := 40 + state % 61
            state = state * 48271 % 2147483647
            lightness := 25 + state % 51
            result = result.append(from_hsl(angle, saturation, lightness))
        return sequence_text(result)
    return "INVALID"

int command_count
scan(&command_count)
string[] registered_names := []
int[][] registered_colors := []
for: 0 <= line < command_count
    string input_line
    scan(&input_line)
    words := input_line.split(" ")
    result := execute(words, &registered_names, &registered_colors)
    println("{result}")
